async function run(groups, other, read, output) {
	for (const [key, batch] of groups) {
		if (key) {
			report(batch.length);
		}
		// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
		const rows = await Promise.all<Row>(
			batch.filter((item) => item.enabled).map(read),
		);
		output.push(...rows);
	}
	for (const [key, batch] of groups) {
		report(key);
		const tasks = batch.filter((item) => item.enabled).map(read);
		// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
		const rows = await Promise.all(tasks);
	}
	for (const [key, batch] of groups) {
		// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
		const rows = await Promise.all(
			other.filter((item) => item.enabled).map(read),
		);
	}
	const orphan = other;
	for (const [key, orphan] of groups) {
		report(orphan.length);
	}
	for (const [key, batch] of groups) {
		// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
		const rows = await Promise.all(orphan.map(read));
	}
}
